Crannogbois,  Loughros Point,  Ardara  F94 R6Y8

Excellent 2 Bed  Cottage & Garage on 0.32 Acre

Enjoying great views of Loughros More Bay

“Walker’s Cottage”


Beautiful setting enjoying terrific views of Loughros More Bay,  situate 3.3 km off the Ardara / Killybegs N56 Roadway and only 3.5 km from Ardara Town.

Constructed in 1925 and extending to 82.44 sq.metres  (887 sq.ft), the cottage is in excellent condition throughout and comprises -

Sitting Room,  Living Room,  Kitchen,  2 No. Bedrooms & Bathroom.  Detached Garage

Externally the grounds are kept impeccably with landscaped lawns and paddock.   



Sitting Room	3.84 m.  x  3.58 m.
			carpet;  sliding door to concrete patio area;  views of Loughros More 			Bay

  

Living Room		4.47 m.  x  4.30 m.
			tiled floor;  open fireplace with back boiler

  

Kitchen		3.24 m.  x  2.34 m.
			fitted units with built-in oven & hob (2025), sink; overlooking rear 			garden;  further internal window overlooking Living Room

  

Rear Porch		Hot press

Bedroom No. 1	4.65 m.  x  2.96 m.
			carpet;  built-in oak fitted wardrobes

Bedroom No. 2	3.74 m.  x  2.41 m.
			carpet

  


Bathroom		2.58 m.  x  2.36 m.
			bath, separate electric shower, toilet and wash basin;  tiled floor and 			lower walls



P.V.C.  Double Glazed Windows		Electric storage heating	All dry-lined

All furniture and white goods included	Septic Tank within Site


Detached Garage	6.16 m.  x  5.53 m.
			vehicular roller door

Landscaped lawns surround the Cottage;  also included is an enclosed paddock where one can enjoy terrific views of Loughros Bay.

BER -  “F”		Ber No. 118388057

Comprised in Folio DL 31296F and extending to 0.13 hectares (0.32 acres)
